messages:
alex p: Heads-up — we need to lock the metric contract for runtime request signals we want in the new dashboards. major decisions: aggregation window, retention, and backfill scope.
maya r: +1. do we have a proposed set of signal names? runtime already emits request_latency_ms, kv_cache_hit, model_variant, route_id.
ryan k: we also have live exporter sending per-token counts. question: dashboards want p50/p95 tail and QPS by route. do we rely on pre-aggregates or roll our own in the pipeline?
sara j: product wants 30d historical for dashboards, but infra wants 90d for trend detection. can we compromise?
maya r: proposal: store raw 1s counters for 7d, 1m aggregates for 90d, rollup to 1h for 365d. keeps cost reasonable.
alex p: agree on levels. for dashboard queries p95 needs high-res for last 24h, 1m is fine for 7d. p95 over 90d can use sampled hourly approximations.
ryan k: exporters: we need to ensure route_id and model_variant are labels; current exporter uses label cardinality ~2000 for route_id — that will explode storage. we should hash route_id and maintain a mapping service.
maya r: yes, let's emit route_id_hashed with prefix and keep an index job that maps top 500 routes to human names. others fall under "route:other".
sara j: UX note: dashboards should surface top routes by qps and allow drilldown to human names when mapping exists. fallback should show hashed id with tooltip.
alex p: backfill scope: runtime logs exist from last 120d but raw payloads are huge. backfill plan: only backfill key metrics (request_latency_ms p50/p95, qps) for top 100 routes for the 120d window. rest start at T0. cost estimate?
ryan k: rough calc: backfilling top100 at 1m aggregation ~ 100 routes * 120d * 1440 samples/day ~ 17M points. with compression ~ small but network/cpu matters. estimate ~ 4-6 hours of mappers on ci-cluster. storage delta ~ 12GB.
maya r: need schema for exporters to add route_id_hashed and sample_rate. propose new prometheus-esque metric names: runtime_request_latency_ms_bucket (labels: route_hash, variant, env), runtime_request_qps_total (route_hash, variant). payload example: ```runtime_request_qps_total{route_hash="r_9f2b",variant="v1"} 42```
ryan k: +1. also add label sampling=full|sampled to indicate if it's sampled. makes downstream corrections possible.
sara j: retention policy decision: agree to maya's 7d raw/90d 1m/365d 1h. product ok with 90d being default view; can surface 365d via timeframe selector.
alex p: owners: eng-platform (alex) will coordinate mapping job + dashboard schema; runtime (maya) will bump exporter to add route_hash & sampling label; eng-obs (ryan) will size backfill job and run it; product (sara) will sign off on dashboard UX. target: schema PR by EOD Wednesday, backfill dry-run next week.
maya r: noted. I'll open exporter PR with tests + local exporter example. tagging @infra-bot for quota check.
infra-bot: Quota check scheduled: estimated 6h cluster time, temporary CPU request bump to ci-cluster required. Approval window: 48h.
ryan k: I'll draft the backfill playbook with commands and a one-click rollback. include data validation steps: spot-check p95 before/after and compare sample-weighted totals.
sara j: can we also get a small eval for dashboard latency? if panels query 1m aggregates for 90d, what's query latency at 30s? need to ensure console SLO.
alex p: noted — eng-platform will run query perf tests against staging dashboard once sample data is in.
maya r: I'll add migration notes and update docs. leaving action items in the thread: 1) maya PR exporter (due Wed EOD), 2) alex mapping job outline + dashboard schema (Wed), 3) ryan backfill playbook + dry-run (next week), 4) sara UX signoff (after dry-run).
alex p: thanks everyone. ping here when PRs are up. :thumbsup:
